name: project-backport-review
title: Project backport review
description: Use this skill when comparing a client/consumer project against the boilerplate template it started from, to find backport candidates and then improve boilerplate itself for the next project.
do-not-use-when: The other side is an unrelated external artefact (blog, docs, an unrelated repo, someone else's AGENTS.md) — use project-learn-from-source instead
Auditing boilerplate alone with no consumer project to compare against — use project-audit instead
Reviewing a specific diff or PR — use code-review instead
when: When comparing a consumer project against the boilerplate template for backport candidates and boilerplate improvements
triggers: improve boilerplate based on this project
anything in here better than boilerplate
